asked.item: Dental brand channel missing from YouTube connect list
Has Manager role on the channel
What am I doing wrong / how to fix

verdict.reason: The help pages say a channel may not appear for a Manager-only role and give the fix of asking the Owner for Owner access, then reconnecting.

steps.text: If you are listed only as a Manager, the channel may not appear when connecting.
Ask the current Owner to make you an Owner of the channel (or transfer ownership to you), then reconnect.
For branded or managed Youtube accounts, you typically need to click into your main account to see all the channels.
